reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: Halden’s mill has stopped. He came to the sanctuary looking for help.

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: He said there wasn’t enough water reaching the wheel. He’s been along the bank, but he couldn’t see what was holding it up.

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: He also asked whether I could help you.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: Good. We may need another pair of hands.

mechanism.speaker: caelan
mechanism.text: Nothing’s caught between the paddles. The axle looks seated, too.

mechanism.speaker: mira
mechanism.text: It is. Look along the supports—nothing’s moved there.

mechanism.speaker: caelan
mechanism.text: So the wheel itself might be all right.

mechanism.speaker: mira
mechanism.text: I think it is. Let’s see what’s reaching it.

race.speaker: caelan
race.text: The brook’s still flowing. It’s only this channel that’s low.

race.speaker: mira
race.text: Which means we follow it back to the intake.

race.speaker: mira
race.text: Yes. Back over the upper bridge, then past the sanctuary steps. The intake’s along the river trail outside the village.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: The wheel’s sound, but it isn’t getting enough water. We’ll follow the millrace back to its intake.

diagnosis.speaker: caelan
diagnosis.text: Back over the upper bridge, then north past the sanctuary steps.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: That’s right. Take the road out of the village. The intake’s along the river trail.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: *points to the limb* There. That limb’s wedged across the screen.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: Look how the water’s pressing it into the bars.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: We won’t pull it clear like that.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: No. We’ll take the pressure off first.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: Under the water in that little stone recess. We’ll deal with it once the intake’s isolated.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: Tell me where you need me.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: I’ll set the bypass below the screen. Keep clear while I turn it.

prepare.speaker: mira
prepare.text: *checks Caelan is clear* That’s fine. Give me a moment.

prepare_done.speaker: mira
prepare_done.text: That’s taken the main flow off it. There’s still water sitting around the catch.

spell_intro.speaker: caelan
spell_intro.text: It can’t fill again while the bypass is open?

spell_intro.speaker: mira
spell_intro.text: No. There’s only what’s trapped there.

spell_intro.speaker: caelan
spell_intro.text: I want to try moving it into the drain.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: *a small, surprised laugh* There. That went where I wanted it.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: And I can see the catch now.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: It felt different. I could keep track of it.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: You had time to do that here.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: I’d like to try it again.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: When we’re back. I’d like to see it properly, too.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: I wish I’d had this when I was working on the Venns’ gate.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: Was the water still flowing against it?

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: Yes. I was trying to hold it back.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: That’s a much heavier job. We’ve stopped anything feeding this pocket.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: I know. I still wanted to manage it.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: Then show me what you were trying when we’ve got some time. For now, you’ve cleared what I needed.

encouragement.speaker: caelan
encouragement.text: *a small, surprised laugh* There. That went where I wanted it.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: And I can see the catch now.

encouragement.speaker: caelan
encouragement.text: It felt different. I could keep track of it.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: You had time to do that here.

encouragement.speaker: caelan
encouragement.text: I’d like to try it again.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: When we’re back. I’d like to see it properly, too.

repair.speaker: mira
repair.text: I can release the catch now. Take the rope.

repair.speaker: mira
repair.text: Keep the limb clear of the bars when I lift the screen.

repair_done.speaker: mira
repair_done.text: Hold it there… Good. You can let go.

repair_done.speaker: mira
repair_done.text: I’ll collect the tools. Then we’ll check the wheel.

repair_done.speaker: caelan
repair_done.text: Thank you for bringing it out today.

repair_done.speaker: caelan
repair_done.text: I want to spend some time learning it. Without something trying to knock me over.

repair_done.speaker: mira
repair_done.text: Come by the workshop when you’re ready. Bring your book.

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: Steadily, too. The wheel’s taking the load again.

verify.speaker: caelan
verify.text: Do we need to check anything else?

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: That’s enough. Let’s tell Halden what was caught.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: There you are. I heard the wheel start.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: A limb was jammed across the intake screen. We cleared it.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: The wheel itself was all right.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: Good. Was there much damage up there?

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: The bank needs care, but the intake mechanism’s sound. We freed the limb and reset the catch.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: I’ll warn the carriers to watch their footing. Thank you.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: Sit down if you need to. The flour can wait another few minutes.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: We’re all right. I think I’d rather hear it running for a bit.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: *after a moment* Thank you, both of you. There’ll be flour for the Festival of Light.

after.speaker: mira
after.text: Bring the blade and your book when you come by. We’ll make some time to practise.

halden_after.speaker: halden
halden_after.text: The flour’s coming through again. Thank you for getting us moving.

reminder.speaker: mira
reminder.text: Show me what you’ve found. We’ll check it together.

halden_waiting.speaker: halden
halden_waiting.text: I’ll leave the checking to you and Mira. There’s still grain waiting for tomorrow’s baking.

reminder_diagnose.speaker: mira
reminder_diagnose.text: Let’s look at the wheel and the channel beside it. We’ll know more once we’ve checked both.

reminder_intake.speaker: mira
reminder_intake.text: We need the north road, past the sanctuary steps. The intake’s along the trail beyond the village.

reminder_prepare.speaker: mira
reminder_prepare.text: The bypass is below the screen. I’ll set it once you’re standing clear.

reminder_spell.speaker: mira
reminder_spell.text: The pressure’s off now. It’s just the water in that stone recess, with the drain beside it.

reminder_repair.speaker: mira
reminder_repair.text: We can reach the catch now. Take the rope by the lever when you’re ready, and I’ll release it.

reminder_verify.speaker: mira
reminder_verify.text: Let’s get back to the wheel and check it’s taking the load. Then we can give Halden some good news.

reminder_report.speaker: mira
reminder_report.text: Halden’s by the mill. Let’s tell him what happened.

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: Keep close once we’re out there. Animals come down to the water, and some of them won’t move aside for us.

warning.speaker: caelan
warning.text: Is that why you brought the launcher?

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: Yes. Rivet’s coming out if we need him, too.

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: And leave the sword sheathed while we’re walking. We’ll want our footing on that bank.

encounter_intro.speaker: caelan
encounter_intro.text: That tree’s down across the water.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: Look at the trunk. Something’s torn into it.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: With tusks that size… It must have. A limb could easily have washed into the intake.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: *steadies his breathing* Give me a moment.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: I thought I’d be able to use it.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: I couldn’t make any of the elements work. I just kept pushing until something happened.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: Then we’ll look at that somewhere quieter. Right now, I want to know whether you can walk comfortably.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: Good. Keep it sheathed while we’re working. The intake’s just ahead.

withdrawal.speaker: mira
withdrawal.text: We’re clear. Keep back from the bend for a moment.

withdrawal.speaker: caelan
withdrawal.text: It’s still between us and the intake.

withdrawal.speaker: mira
withdrawal.text: Yes. We’ll face it together when we go back up. Stay where I can see you.

retry.speaker: mira
retry.text: Keep your feet under you, Caelan. We’ll take the bend together.

retry.speaker: mira
retry.text: Watch for its head going down. Give yourself room to turn.

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: Keep close once we’re out there. Animals come down to the water, and some of them won’t move aside for us.

reminder_warning.speaker: caelan
reminder_warning.text: Is that why you brought the launcher?

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: Yes. Rivet’s coming out if we need him, too.

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: And leave the sword sheathed while we’re walking. We’ll want our footing on that bank.

reminder_encounter.speaker: mira
reminder_encounter.text: The intake is beyond the bend in the north trail. Stay close—we’ll keep an eye on the riverbank together.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: *points to the limb* There. That limb’s wedged across the screen.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: A fresh break, just like the tree by the path. That’s where it came from. Look how the water’s pressing it into the bars.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: *secures the bolt launcher beside the screen* We’ll need both hands for the tools now.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: We won’t pull it clear like that.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: No. We’ll take the pressure off first.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: Under the water in that little stone recess. We’ll deal with it once the intake’s isolated.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: Tell me where you need me.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: I’ll set the bypass below the screen. Keep clear while I turn it.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: There you are. I heard the wheel start.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: A limb was jammed across the intake screen. We cleared it.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: The wheel itself was all right.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: Good. Was there much damage up there?

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: There was a ridgeback tusker by the path. It must have brought the tree down.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *his expression changes* You ran into it?

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: It’s gone. But the bank’s torn up—warn anyone carrying loads along there.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: I will. Are you both all right?

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: Sit down if you need to. The flour can wait another few minutes.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: We’re all right. I think I’d rather hear it running for a bit.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *after a moment* Thank you, both of you. There’ll be flour for the Festival of Light.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: *kneels beside him and secures a bandage over the scrape* Easy, Caelan. I’ve got you.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: *draws a breath* Give me a moment.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: I thought I’d be able to use it.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: I couldn’t make any of the elements work. I just kept pushing until something happened.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: Then we’ll look at that somewhere quieter. Can you get your foot under you?

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: *helps him up and checks the bandage* Keep it sheathed while we’re working. We’ll take the bank slowly.

repair_done_combat.speaker: mira
repair_done_combat.text: Hold it there… Good. You can let go.

repair_done_combat.speaker: mira
repair_done_combat.text: I’ll collect the tools and the launcher. Then we’ll check the wheel.

repair_done_combat.speaker: caelan
repair_done_combat.text: Thank you for bringing it out today.

repair_done_combat.speaker: caelan
repair_done_combat.text: I want to spend some time learning it. Without something trying to knock me over.

repair_done_combat.speaker: mira
repair_done_combat.text: Come by the workshop when you’re ready. Bring your book.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: There’s something else. I was going to keep this until your birthday.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: Here. Take it by the grip.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: Mind the blade. You can stare at the mechanism after you’ve got hold of it.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: I made the housing. The ring brings each focus into position. Turn it until you feel it catch.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: Water. Green for Nature, red for Fire, white for Ice.

gift.speaker: caelan
gift.text: And I channel through whichever one I choose?

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: Yes. The grip stays still. Move the ring, then direct your aether through the focus.

gift.speaker: caelan
gift.text: I was going to practise today.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: Then take it with you when you do.

gift.speaker: caelan
gift.text: *quietly* Thank you. I don’t quite know what to say.

gift.speaker: mira
gift.text: You don’t have to decide now. Tell me how it feels.

gift.speaker: caelan
gift.text: Different. Let me hold it a moment.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath.text: *steadies his breathing* You made that look easier than it felt.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath.text: It wasn’t easy. Are you hurt?

legacy_aftermath.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath.text: Let me look first. *checks his hands and shoulders*

legacy_aftermath.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath.text: I could barely get near it.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath.text: The launcher let me stand clear, and Rivet watched our flank. I was glad to have you beside me.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath.text: Next time I’m bringing more than my hands.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath.text: *a small, relieved laugh* A sound improvement.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath.text: Rivet’s folded away. We’ll take the bank slowly. The intake’s just ahead.

legacy_aftermath.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath.text: *picks up the tool roll* Let’s see if that’s where our limb ended up.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: *kneels beside him and secures a bandage over the scrape* Easy. I’ve got you.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: I could barely get near it.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: I could stand back and aim. Can you stand?

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: *gets a foot under him* I think so.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: *helps him up and checks the bandage* Rivet’s back in the kit. Keep beside me. We’ll take the bank slowly.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: Next time I’m bringing more than my hands.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: *breathes out a small, relieved laugh* A sound improvement.

legacy_aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
legacy_aftermath_recovered.text: *picks up the tool roll* Let’s see if that’s where our limb ended up.

legacy_spell_intro.speaker: caelan
legacy_spell_intro.text: I could move that into the drain.

legacy_spell_intro.speaker: mira
legacy_spell_intro.text: Just the water in the recess?

legacy_spell_intro.speaker: caelan
legacy_spell_intro.text: Yes. There’s nowhere for more to come through now.

legacy_encouragement.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement.text: It did. I can reach the catch now.

legacy_encouragement.speaker: caelan
legacy_encouragement.text: You make it sound very impressive.

legacy_encouragement.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement.text: I make it sound useful. I was going to have to scoop that out.

legacy_encouragement.speaker: caelan
legacy_encouragement.text: *laughs* Then I’m glad to have saved you the trouble.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: It did. I can reach the catch now.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: *a small smile* I thought it would.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: *his smile fades a little* I couldn’t do it at the Venns’. I wanted to spare them the trouble, and I still ended up borrowing their tools.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: You were fighting a current there. This was a smaller job.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: I know. I just wish I’d managed both.

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: You got their water running again, didn’t you?

legacy_encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
legacy_encouragement_failed.text: *gently* And you’ve cleared this catch for me. Give yourself that much.

legacy_repair_done.speaker: mira
legacy_repair_done.text: *with relief* There. Hold it a moment… Good. You can let go.

legacy_repair_done.speaker: mira
legacy_repair_done.text: It is. Let’s go back and see what the wheel makes of it.

legacy_repair_done_combat.speaker: mira
legacy_repair_done_combat.text: *with relief* There. Hold it a moment… Good. You can let go.

legacy_repair_done_combat.speaker: mira
legacy_repair_done_combat.text: It is. I’ll get the launcher. Let’s go back and see what the wheel makes of it.

legacy_after.speaker: mira
legacy_after.text: *smiles* It hasn’t learned to finish itself.

tutorial_preparation.speaker: mira
tutorial_preparation.text: Take a moment before we go any closer. I’ll finish checking the kit.
